Mix of full-depth and half-depth bins with dividers provides varied small-parts storage. View from above (polar 10) shows all compartments populated with example hardware props.

finish.summary: Built a compact 7-cell honeycomb organizer (center plus 6 neighbors) with 7 bin inserts providing 16 separate compartments, well above the 6-bin requirement. Uses full-depth div2/div3 and half-depth div2/div3 bins for varied small-parts sizes, with open faces capped and joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
